cleavage agent: digested in-gel with 100 ng Trypsin (Promega V5111)
enrichment method: Reactive protein fractions were subsequently purified by affinity chromatography using Protein G HP SpinTrap columns (GE Healthcare)
fractionation method: protein fractions were obtained by separating cell extracts based on molecular weight using a Sephacryl S200 HR column (GE Healthcare, Hertfordshire, UK)
labeling: The resulting peptides were recovered by elution and analyzed by nano LC-MS/MS at the Proteomics Core Facility of the CEQUIBIEM, Faculty of Exact Sciences, University of Buenos Aires/IQUIBICEN CONICET.
